summary: Field Status feature on Dashboard and TV Dashboard tested successfully. All features working: Dashboard shows Field Status card with total ready count, progress bar, colour dots, FULL LOAD badge (>=10), amber partial styling (<10), clickable navigation to /field. TV Dashboard shows same data. Field page +/- buttons work and changes reflect on Dashboard after refresh.
passed_tests: Dashboard loads with Field Status card (data-testid: dashboard-field-status)
Dashboard Field Status shows total ready count and progress bar
Dashboard Field Status shows per-colour breakdown dots for colours with ready > 0
Dashboard Field Status card is clickable and navigates to /field
When total ready >= 10, dashboard shows FULL LOAD badge (data-testid: dashboard-full-load-badge)
When total ready > 0 but < 10, dashboard shows amber partial status styling
TV Dashboard shows Field Status card (data-testid: tv-field-status)
TV Dashboard Field Status shows total ready, progress bar, and colour dots
TV Dashboard shows '1 FULL' badge when total >= 10
Field page still works: Field Status section with +/- buttons
Adjusting field status on Field page reflects on Dashboard after refresh
Backend GET /api/field-status returns current counts (200 OK)
Backend PUT /api/field-status updates counts correctly (200 OK)
Backend field-status endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
